asset.name: Aave

score_rationales.supply: Tokenomics are tight: max supply is capped at 16,000,000 with ~15.18M circulating (~94.9%), so inflation from new mint is negligible. Centralized exchange balances tracked by CryptoQuant rose from ~2.07M to ~2.23M AAVE since early February 2026 (~14.7% of circulating), lifting sell-side inventory above its 90-day average after a prior decline. Roughly one-sixth of supply is committed to the Safety Module (DAO figures cite ~16.78% staked) while stkAAVE incentives were repeatedly reduced by governance (~220–260 AAVE/day), which offsets but does not remove the recent CEX buildup.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: DefiLlama (protocol parent#aave) shows ~$11.90B supplied and ~$9.42B borrowed on Ethereum, with major nine-figure supplied liquidity on Arbitrum (~$600M), Base (~$449M), and Plasma (~$402M), indicating dominant money-market usage and multi-chain deployment rather than a single-chain niche.
score_rationales.value_capture: Daily revenue: $202K (~$73.8M/year). TVL: $15.00B. Revenue/TVL ratio: 0.49%. Daily fees: $1.4M.
